name: jamie-wigg-toolkit
description: Project-level Claude Code toolkit for the jamie-wigg repo: bundles the project skill, hooks, and review subagents into one installable unit. Pairs with the global hyperframes skill ecosystem (installed separately via skills-lock.json).
author: wiggjamie9-afk

depends.note: These global skills are installed via skills-lock.json from heygen-com/hyperframes.

install.instructions: Already wired in via .claude/settings.json. To replicate in another repo, copy the .claude/ directory and run `chmod +x .claude/hooks/*.sh`.
